force_component_measurement.bonded_and_lj: OpenMM analytical reference; raw LAMMPS component energies differentiated independently
force_component_measurement.coulomb: LAMMPS total minus independently verified OpenMM bonded and LJ; not a native separate observable

numerical_input_addendum:
# Four-layer convention identity a25ced2fd36fa6ff2c7ea91299f79d4e6239c2e2630da17bda50f4c9a8e4d835
# Execution mode diagnostic; backend policy source_replay_v1
# Backend-only choices are not author authority. MD is blocked.
units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p
newton on
atom_modify sort 0 0
dielectric 1
bond_style harmonic
angle_style harmonic
dihedral_style opls
improper_style harmonic
pair_style lj/charmm/coul/long 9 11
pair_modify mix geometric shift no tail no table 12
special_bonds lj/coul 0 0 0.5
kspace_style pppm 0.0001
neighbor 2 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check no
read_data ../system.data
include ../coefficients.in
solver_partitions_comparable: only in matched-ewald control (same alpha); reciprocal truncations are separately converged
